name: The Trio
overview: Middle-aged Hugo encounters his childhood loves' daughter, sending him back to when his younger self begins college. His memories offer a glimpse into a deeply entwined and emotionally complex story of yearning, as a love triangle becomes increasingly complicated. Tracing the emotional journeys of lead characters Hugo, Thora, and August.
